name: Raising Spirits

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you hear Gor'mul mourn its fallen might and question whether a simple trinket can restore its lost glory.
As a warrior, you hear of an orc whose fighting spirit has been extinguished by despair and grief over a cowardly strike.

faq.answer: A Horde emissary brings Gor'mul a Raptor Talon Amulet, hoping it will rekindle the despondent warrior's fighting spirit.
Gor'mul is a warrior consumed by despair after the mightiest champions fell to cowardly hands. He dismisses tokens and doubts the Horde can regain its former glory.

aliases: what does raptor talon amulet do
faq.answer: The Raptor Talon Amulet is crafted from polished bone and raptor talons. It is brought to Gor'mul in hope that it can channel raptors' natural strength and ferocity to awaken his inner flame.
faq.q: Why is the Raptor Talon Amulet brought to Gor'mul?

faq.answer: Gor'mul despairs after seeing the mightiest champions slain by cowardly hands. Their fall leaves him convinced that honor and strength can be snuffed out, breaking his will to fight.
Gor'mul rejects the gift as mere polished bone. He believes it cannot restore the Horde or undo the tragedy he laments.
faq.q: How does Gor'mul react to the amulet?

faq.answer: Gor'mul doubts the Horde can reclaim its former glory, seeing little hope when treachery can strike down even the greatest heroes.
faq.q: What does Gor'mul say about the Horde?

sections.body: An emissary brings Gor'mul a Raptor Talon Amulet, hoping its power will reach him. The talisman channels the wild strength and ferocity of raptors. It is meant to rekindle the flame that once burned fiercely within the orc warrior.
sections.title: A Spark for a Fallen Flame

sections.body: Gor'mul answers the gift with bitter grief. He remembers the mightiest champions struck down by cowardly hands and rejects the talisman as polished bone. He doubts any trinket can restore the Horde to its former glory.
sections.title: Bitterness and Despair

summary: A Horde emissary hopes Raising Spirits will help Gor'mul find his fighting spirit again. The Raptor Talon Amulet is meant to rekindle it, but Gor'mul remains bitter and doubts any trinket can restore the Horde's former glory.
